card.name: Odd mid-string pieces in codes and numbers
card.fires_on: Short pieces in the middle of strings: a space in a date format, a letter inside a URL id, the first digit of a number, or the start of a split word like Invert or Pneumocystis.

modes.label: Digits inside numbers
modes.description: A leading or middle digit of a dose or dollar amount, often right before more digits.

modes.label: Split words
modes.description: The start of a word broken into pieces, such as Invert Sugar or Pneumocystis.
modes.example: Ringer's Injection, USP<< In>>vert Sugar, 10% in

modes.label: Code and URL characters
modes.description: A single character inside a URL id or a date format string.

card.plain: It fires on small pieces in the middle of numbers, web codes and long split words, where the next piece is hard to guess.
